about.title: CareerRaah.pk Ke Baare Mein
about.subtitle: Hamara Maqsad aur Tareeqa Kaar
about.missionText: CareerRaah.pk Pakistani students aur freshers ko informed career decisions lene mein madad karta hai data-driven guidance provide karke jo unke unique halaat ko consider karta hai — education, skills, budget, location, aur interests.
about.methodologyTitle: Hamara Matching Kaise Kaam Karta Hai
about.methodologyText: Hamara algorithm har career ko 0-100 ke scale pe score karta hai paanch weighted factors use karke:
about.factor1: Interest Fit (RIASEC): 35% — Aap ki dilchaspiyan career ke profile se kitni match karti hain
about.factor2: Skill Fit: 25% — Aap ki current skills career ki zaroorat se kitni match karti hain
about.factor3: Eligibility: 15% — Aap ka education background qualify karta hai ya nahi
about.factor4: Budget aur Waqt: 15% — Career aap ke available resources mein fit hota hai ya nahi
about.factor5: Preferences: 10% — Location, kaam ki qism, aur doosri preferences
about.dataSourcesTitle: Hamara Data Kahan Se Aata Hai
about.dataSourcesText: Hum multiple sources se takhmeeni data jama karte hain aur cross-reference karte hain:
sources: Rozee.pk — Pakistan ka sabse bada job portal salary data aur job trends ke liye
Mustakbil.com — Career aur salary ki maloomat
Pakistan Bureau of Statistics — Labour Force Survey data
LinkedIn aur Glassdoor — International salary comparisons
University websites — Admission requirements aur fee structures
Community forums — Reddit, Facebook groups, aur professional networks
FPSC, PPSC, NTS — Sarkari naukri exam data
about.disclaimerText: CareerRaah.pk ka sara data takhmeeni hai aur sirf rahnumai ke liye hai. Salary ranges, competition levels, aur timelines publicly available information ke basis pe estimates hain. Hum strongly recommend karte hain ke koi bhi badi career ya financial decision lene se pehle information zaroor verify karein. Ye platform professional career counseling ki jagah nahi le sakta.
about.updateNote: Hum har 6 mahine career data update karne ki koshish karte hain. Aakhri comprehensive update: September 2025.
